# BTS fixture excerpts (real public-domain data)

Unmodified rows (all columns) selected from TranStats downloads made on 2026-10-15:

- `p52_2025q1_excerpt.zip`: Form 41 Schedule P-5.2 (table FMK), year 2025, quarter 1, rows for
  aircraft type 694 (A320-100/200) of DL, UA, F9 and GCA, type 683 (B777-F) of FX, and the
  unattributed type 999 rows of DL and FX.
- `t2_2025q1_excerpt.zip`: Air Carrier Summary T2 (table FIH), the same carrier/type/quarter
  selection, all service classes.
- `l_aircraft_type_excerpt.csv`: rows of the TranStats `L_AIRCRAFT_TYPE` lookup.

Source: U.S. Bureau of Transportation Statistics, https://www.transtats.bts.gov/ (public domain;
citation required). Used only by offline tests.
